# Skill: Role-Aware Correction

## Role rules

- Contributor: may receive and accept suggestions for their own draft.
- Moderator: may explain policy findings and decide review outcomes, but may not rewrite a contributor's draft as if they were the contributor.
- Marketplace Administrator: may configure schemas, categories, thresholds, and advertising policy; may decide moderation outcomes.
- Super Administrator: may override policy only with an auditable reason.
- Visitor: cannot edit, process, approve, or publish.

## Suggestion classes

Use clarity, completeness, privacy, safety, and accuracy. Privacy and safety findings may block. Clarity, completeness, and accuracy suggestions normally require contributor choice.

Every suggestion includes a stable ID, field/range, original text, proposed text, class, reason, confidence, blocking flag, and Accept/Reject/Edit actions.
